newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's AvtoVAZ carmaker raises output estimate.
newsitem.headline: Russia's AvtoVAZ carmaker raises output estimate.

text.p: Russia's largest auto maker AO AvtoVAZ has increased its estimate of 1996 production to 670,000 vehicles from an earlier 654,000, a company official said on Wednesday.
Vladimir Kolpachkov, head of the production planning area of AvtoVAZ, said by telephone that the firm based in Togliatti, a city on the Volga River, had increased its output expectations.
Kolpachkov said production had risen to 552,600 vehicles in the first 10 months of 1996 from 511,050 in the same 1995 period.
He said AvtoVAZ had produced 56,100 Niva off-road vehicles, against 59,175 in 1995.
All other production was of Lada cars, known in Russia as Zhigulis, he said.
